jobs.title: Graphic Designer & AI Creative Specialist
jobs.description:
**GPS Marketing Agency Is Hiring: Arabic-Speaking Graphic Designer & AI Creative Specialist**

GPS Marketing Agency is looking for a creative Graphic Designer with strong digital marketing and AI skills to join our team in Dubai.

The ideal candidate must be fluent in Arabic, have previous marketing agency experience, and be able to create stylish, high-quality designs across different industries.

**Requirements:**

* Fluent Arabic is mandatory, including professional writing and proofreading.
* Good English communication skills.
* Previous experience in a digital marketing, advertising, or creative agency.
* Strong graphic design skills and a creative portfolio.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Knowledge of Adobe InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, and Canva is an advantage.
* Professional experience with AI creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, ChatGPT, or other AI image-generation and design tools.
* Ability to use AI tools effectively to generate, edit, and enhance visuals while maintaining professional design quality.
* Knowledge of Figma or other UI/UX design tools is a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create social media posts, carousels, banners, and digital advertisements.
* Develop Arabic and English marketing creatives for real estate, healthcare, and corporate brands.
* Use AI tools to generate and enhance creative content.
* Maintain brand consistency and deliver high-quality designs on time.
* Collaborate with the marketing team and communicate with clients.

**Position Details:**

Location: JLT, Dubai — On-site

Salary: AED 6,000 per month

How to Apply: Send your CV and portfolio to digital@gpsmarketing.agency.

Applications without a portfolio or the required Arabic proficiency will not be considered.

Pay: AED6,000.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you in Dubai?
* When can you start?
* Add the link to your Portfolio (MUST)
* Do you have previous work experience in a digital marketing, advertising, or creative agency?
* Are you fluent in Arabic and able to independently write and proofread professional Arabic marketing content?
* Which design and AI tools have you used professionally?
* Do you have professional experience creating social media designs and marketing creatives for brands or clients?
* What is your visa status and expiration date?

Experience:

* UI UX design: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Elevar Media (elevargrowth) is a Dubai-based marketing agency specialising in sport, culture and entertainment. We create campaigns and content for brands, clubs and leagues that people want to watch, share and talk about.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Creative Producer to lead the creative and commercial success of our campaign and content work across sport, culture and social. You'll lead pitches, set the creative standard, take projects from idea to final delivery, and lead the production team and project manager. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can win great work and make sure it gets made well and profitably.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead pitches from concept to presentation, shaping creative strategy, treatments and storytelling, and work with Business Development on pricing and scope so projects are competitive and profitable.
* Lead creative productions from concept to final delivery across video, photography and social content, developing concepts, treatments, moodboards and scripts that balance bold ideas with feasibility.
* Own project budgets, margin and profitability, working with your Project Managers on day-to-day tracking.
* Lead and mentor the production team, with Project Managers, producers and editors reporting to you.
* Oversee pre-production, production and post-production, including shoots, crews, talent, locations and logistics, spotting risks early and solving problems as they arise.
* Build and manage a trusted network of directors, DOPs, photographers, videographers, editors, stylists and freelancers.
* Give clear, actionable creative direction to directors, editors and post-production teams.
* Work directly with clients and senior stakeholders to shape briefs, manage expectations and turn projects into repeat or retainer business.
* Report to senior leadership on project performance, margin and opportunities to grow the vertical.

**What We're Looking For**

* 7+ years in creative production, advertising, media, film or branded content.
* A proven record as a Senior Creative Producer, Senior Producer or similar role, delivering projects from concept to completion.
* Experience leading production teams, including project managers or producers.
* Experience pitching and presenting creative work to clients, including negotiating budgets and scope.
* Strong budgeting, P&L and resource-management skills.
* Strong knowledge of video production, photography and post-production, including Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Experience in sport, culture, entertainment, lifestyle or social content (highly desirable).
* Sharp creative judgment, attention to detail and clear communication, with the ability to run several projects at once. Fluent English.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You move easily between the creative and commercial sides of a project. You win clients with strong ideas, lead a team, manage the numbers and make calls when plans change. You understand sport, culture and social, and know how to turn strong ideas into content people engage with.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV and a portfolio to **letstalk@elevargrowth.com**

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
**Job title:** Creative Director

**Company:** Crystal Arc Factory L.L.C.  
**Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates (On-site)  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About the role**

Crystal Arc Factory is looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision. You will own our brand look and feel and the visual quality of everything customers see. That covers product and packaging design, catalogues, marketing, digital content and exhibitions. You will report to the Managing Director and lead our team of graphic designers.

**What you will do**

* Define and protect our brand identity, tone and visual guidelines across all products, channels and markets
* Turn business and sales goals into clear campaign concepts and creative strategies
* Guide the design of new products, finishes and packaging with our Production, Sales and Product teams
* Approve catalogues, brochures, presentations, photography, video, social media and website content before release
* Make sure creative work can be produced in our factory within agreed cost, material and timeline limits
* Lead, brief and develop designers, including remote and freelance team members
* Prepare the annual creative plan and budget, and manage agencies, photographers, printers and other suppliers
* Protect company IP, including source files, licences, fonts and image rights

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, Marketing or a related field
* 8–15 years of creative experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role. Manufacturing, interiors, furniture, building products or consumer products is ideal
* A strong portfolio showing brand, product or packaging work from concept to production
* Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and strong in Figma or similar. 3D/rendering knowledge is an advantage
* Excellent sense of typography, colour, layout and material
* Strong leadership, communication and presentation skills
* Project and budget management skills, and comfort working to deadlines with Sales, Production and Marketing
* Fluent English. Arabic is an advantage, and understanding of the GCC market is preferred

**Why join us**

* Shape the brand of a manufacturer, from first concept to finished product
* Lead and grow a creative team
* Work closely with senior management
* Office-based in Dubai, with visits to our factory, suppliers, exhibitions and clients across the UAE and GCC

**How to apply**

Send your CV and portfolio to **hr@crystalarc.net** with the subject line "Creative Director – Dubai".

#CreativeDirector #DubaiJobs #UAEJobs #Hiring #Design #BrandDesign #CrystalArc

Pay: AED8,000.00 - AED15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
